metaDescription: Shopify store for Negative Apparel, a women's fashion label: dresses, co-ords, lingerie and loungewear, curvy and winter edits, and a mobile bottom bar.
summary: Shopify store for a contemporary women's fashion brand selling dresses, co-ords, lingerie and loungewear.
overview: Negative Apparel describes itself as contemporary women's fashion with global styles, selling dresses, co-ord sets, tops, bottoms, lingerie, sleepwear, bags and beauty. We built Negative Apparel's Shopify store to carry a fast-changing catalog of new drops.
challenge: New styles arrive often and the range covers everything from office suits to lingerie. Shoppers need quick routes into dresses, co-ords or sleepwear, and separate edits for curvy sizes, winter, beauty and accessories.
approach: A top row of tabs switches between Women, Winters, Curvy, Beauty and Accessories, while a second menu covers new arrivals, dresses, co-ord sets, tops, bottoms, lingerie, loungewear and kids. The home page leads with a campaign banner and a tabbed new drops grid for tops, pants and dresses, followed by category banners. Product pages show color swatches, size buttons, quantity, add to cart and buy it now, and a currency selector in the header shows prices in PKR.
outcome: A product-dense Shopify store where shoppers can switch between edits, browse new drops by type and buy in a few taps, with a fixed bottom bar on mobile. Each edit has its own landing page, so the team can feature curvy, winter or beauty ranges without crowding the main menu.

process.title: Navigation
process.body: Edit tabs for women, winters, curvy, beauty and accessories sit above a category menu with dropdowns for dresses, co-ords, tops, bottoms, lingerie and loungewear.

process.title: Home page
process.body: A campaign banner leads into a new drops grid that switches between tops, pants and dresses, then large lingerie and dresses banners.

process.title: Collections and products
process.body: Collection pages offer filters, sorting and several grid densities. Product pages show image galleries, color swatches, size buttons and two purchase buttons.

process.title: Mobile
process.body: A fixed bottom bar gives home, menu, search and cart on every page, with the edit tabs kept under the logo.

whyItMatters: Fashion stores with frequent drops live on repeat visits. Fast routes to what is new, by type, give returning shoppers a reason to check back.

faqs.q: What platform is the Negative Apparel store built on?
faqs.a: It runs on Shopify with the Ecomus theme, using collections for each category and edit, color and size options, and a currency selector.

faqs.q: Can Pixel2Tech build a similar Shopify store for my brand?
faqs.a: Yes. We design and build Shopify stores for fashion brands, including edit tabs, new drop grids and mobile bottom navigation. Tell us about your catalog and we will send a fixed quote after a short call.
